name: Mercure Langkawi Pantai Cenang
short_description: The first Accor resort in Langkawi, opened April 2022, a 5-minute walk from Cenang Beach and Underwater World with Sleep Number beds in every room.
ai_summary: Mercure Langkawi Pantai Cenang opened April 1, 2022 as the first Accor Hotels resort in Langkawi, a 5-minute walk from Cenang Beach and the Underwater World aquarium. Every room includes a private balcony or patio and a Sleep Number bed, and the resort's spacious pool and diverse breakfast draw consistent praise. Guests consistently highlight the hotel's cleanliness and sunset views, along with kid-friendly touches that make it a popular family pick, though a subset of early reviews noted new-build issues like bathroom odor and a still-developing gym.
